props.label: Auto Production
props.description: Workcenter must allow Auto Production, User must enable auto production for Fuuz Production Setup Output in order to utilize the feature and allow PLC to auto post production.

props.label: Cavity Output
props.description:
A value that can be set on each output, which then can be correlated to a production and/or scrap IoT tag type - this value should be set by the Operator, Setup Person, PLC or some other programmatic method - the corresponding value on the Tag associated with this device would be static.

Maybe called a cavity number or cavity ID in some ERP systems.

props.label: Run Sync
